verdict.rationale: The evidence for Docker shipping preconfigured is indirect. First-party docs only mention Docker as the backend for running Windows in a VM. A community security report says Omarchy added the default user to the docker group by default, which implies Docker came installed and usable without setup. A defender notes this was quickly changed, so out-of-the-box usability without sudo or extra setup may no longer hold. Missing for 10: first-party documentation that Docker or other container tools are preinstalled and enabled, clarity on current post-fix behavior, and coverage of other container tooling (Podman, compose, lazydocker).
